Investigative writer Seth Harp exposes murder and drug trafficking inside America's largest military base in this Tucker Carlson episode. Harp reported on a string of deaths and crimes at the vast Army post. His dispatch paints a base where cartels and soldiers mix in the shadows.

Harp walks through the cases he uncovered, from overdoses to unsolved killings. He argues the Army looked away while trafficking ran through its own ranks. Carlson asks how such rot hides in plain sight at a flagship base. Brave and disturbed viewers get a chilling probe into a scandal the brass would rather bury.
